profile.headline: Senior Staff UI Engineer @ Cribl
profile.summary:
Principal UI Developer @ Splunk

I once was a UI Developer for Coldwater Creek. Before that, I was the webmaster for the LSU Alumni Association. And before that, was the Marketing Coordinator/Web Developer for a startup in Seattle name Vykor.

In college, I maintained and helped develop the website for the Center for Instructional Technology and Distance Learning(CITDL)

Specialties: The UI Trinity (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). React, Backbone, LESS/SASS, and a healthy slice of the giant pie of JS libraries.

I work with Windows and OSX.

Stuff: JIRA, Bitbucket, Gitlab, Git, Confluence, Jenkins, Jest, Mocha, Sinon, Webdriver IO, Slack, Webpack, Grunt, Yarn, Node... I'm sure there's more.

positions.title: Freelance Web/Flash Designer
positions.description: I design Websites and Flash media.

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description: Made the internets pretty for www.coldwatercreek.com.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: I maintain, update, and change the current LSU AA website.  I do all of my layout, design, and graphics.  I also help with company events, marketing, and anything planning.  Additionally, I am the admin to the Harris online "Alumni Connections" site.

positions.title: Marketing Communications
positions.description: Designed marketing promotions via Flash-based Demos, logo infused products, and DVD packaging.  I also maintained the website.
